items.title: SD-e1 absolute-vs-residual output_proj A/B on the ITEM 1 ON arm (chip-20260901-sde1-outputproj-residual-ab-exq)
items.note: Fires the design doc's own pre-registered 'absolute-vs-residual branch' (REE_assembly/docs/architecture/sd_e1_rollout_consistency_training.md, 'FIRED (substrate landed 2026-09-01)'): V3-EXQ-965 (confirmed autopsy 2026-08-30) validated SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training ITEM 1 (E1's action-conditioned transition), but the ITEM-1-ON arm still shows crushed per-action divergence relative to the evaluator bar (cr_ratio(h=1) 25-37x short of 0.1) -- the exact condition the branch fires on. chip-20260901-sde1-outputproj-residual-knob (ree-v3 2026-09-01) built E1Config.output_proj_residual (default off), switching E1's rollout read-out from absolute-next-state to a residual state_i+delta form in BOTH rollout branches (forward()/predict_long_horizon()); 16/16 contract tests passing (re-confirmed here). This entry is the owed A/B: ARM_absolute (output_proj_residual=False) vs ARM_residual (output_proj_residual=True), BOTH on the ITEM-1-ON configuration (action_conditioned_transition=True, action_cond_unzero_self_slot=True -- fixed EXPLICITLY and identically in both arms per substrate_queue.json's own open_decision note, so this A/B is not confounded by that sub-flag), seeds [42,123] matching 954/965. Reuses the 954/965 methodology unchanged (SD-070 z_world warmup, bespoke E1/E2 training, goal template, multi-horizon cr_ratio(h) sweep, direct-channel Phase 4c per-action probe) with 2 arms instead of 3 (no A_off needed -- ITEM 1's own action-blindness-vs-signal question was already answered by V3-EXQ-965) and a residual-vs-absolute decision rule replacing 965's ON-vs-OFF one. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): checked cr_ratio_h1/per-action-divergence readouts via REE_assembly/scripts/reanalysis_query.py -- 3 manifests scanned (V3-EXQ-954, 108a, 108b), none carries the readout on a substrate with output_proj_residual (the knob postdates every existing manifest, including 965 itself). Not recoverable -> authored. Step 2.5c (substrate-path overlap gate): SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training itself (severity corrupting, e1_deep.py::forward/::predict_long_horizon) IS this build's own target entry -- sanctioned exception per its own substrate_gate_note, not a route-around. Three OTHER open corrupting entries overlap this driver's imports at the FILE level (mode-governance-engagement and SD-082 both list bare ree_core/agent.py; contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy lists e1_deep.py::ContextMemory.write) and were VERIFIED UNREACHED, not dismissed: SalienceCoordinator.tick() and the lateral_pfc bias-head consumer are both invoked exclusively from within REEAgent.select_action() (grep-verified sole call sites), which this driver family (954/965/968) never calls (env stepped directly with random actions); ContextMemory.write() is called only from E1DeepPredictor.update_from_observation() (grep-verified sole call site), never invoked here (every state transition goes through predict_long_horizon()/forward(), read()-only). Full citations in the script's own module docstring Step-2.5c section. DV-SYMMETRY INVARIANCE (Step 3, mandatory declaration): an early draft assumed a frozen-model h=1 algebraic identity (pairwise_dist/spread invariant to the flag) would hold and added a 'sanity' precondition on it; a --dry-run smoke falsified that (spread differed ~44% after 2 training episodes) because ARM_absolute/ARM_residual are INDEPENDENTLY TRAINED, not a shared frozen model with a flag toggled at read-out -- the flawed precondition was removed rather than patched (see the script docstring's DV-SYMMETRY INVARIANCE section for the full derivation and correction). red-team (fable): CONTESTED, not BLOCKING -- 4 findings, all addressed before queuing: (1) the residual base 'state_i' is prior_generator's learned projection (prior_full), not raw z_world -- docstring corrected with a RESIDUAL BASE CLARIFICATION section, does not change what the script measures (it tests the landed knob's actual behavior); (2) a NaN cr_ratio(h=1) (CR_rollout centroid_norm collapsing toward 0) could silently read as 'no_material_difference' -- fixed with a new cr_ratio_h1_finite P0 readiness precondition, self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue instead; (3) per_seed_lift's spread/centroid_norm decomposition fields were sourced from the wrong probe (Phase 4c action_probe instead of the Phase 4/4b cr_rollout_by_h[1] that actually composes the label statistic) -- fixed by adding correctly-sourced cr_rollout_spread_h1_*/cr_rollout_centroid_norm_h1_* fields and renaming the Phase 4c fields to action_probe_*; also added a symmetric dv_symmetry_note caveat (previously only the 'below' direction was flagged as a possible centroid-norm artifact, now both 'exceeds' and 'below' are); (4) LIFT_FACTOR from a 2-sample noise estimate (minor, matches 965 precedent, not fixed). Re-verified post-fix: validate_experiments.py --strict clean, validate_recording.py --strict clean on the smoke manifest, --dry-run smoke PASS with the new precondition passing. Two claims (MECH-135, INV-088) remain pending_retest_after_substrate regardless of this run's outcome -- claim_ids=[] deliberately, per the same claim-tagging-accuracy convention V3-EXQ-965 used.
